# Testudo — AI Agent Trading Platform
> Programmatic trade execution, real-time risk alerts, and journal-as-memory for autonomous AI agents.

## Quick Start
- [Agent Trading Guide](/AGENT_TRADING.md) — complete onboarding for AI agents
- [API Reference](/docs/10-api-reference) — REST endpoints and WebSocket channels
- [Agent Architecture](/docs/11-agent-trading) — docs page with copy-to-clipboard

## Agent Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/signals` — submit trades with reasoning, confidence, setup tags
- `GET /api/v1/journal/agent/summary?format=llm` — performance as LLM-ready markdown
- `GET /api/v1/journal/agent/insights` — coach pattern detection
- `POST /api/v1/journal/agent/compare` — period-over-period comparison
- WebSocket `agent.execution.{user_id}` — real-time fill confirmations
- WebSocket `agent.alert.{user_id}` — risk breach notifications
